description: Jake's Resume Builder & Line-by-Line Resume Auditing Rejectless is a resume tool built specifically for software engineers. It combines a pixel-perfect **Jake's Resume builder** with a line-by-line resume linting engine — so your formatting and your content are both interview-ready. Unlike AI tools that rewrite your resume for you, Rejectless audits what you've already written. It flags vague claims, missing metrics, and weak framing bullet by bullet — and gives you concrete next actions instead
